# skate1 for Android (arm64): builds libmain.so, which SDL's Java activity
# loads and enters through SDL_main.
#
# Uses the code generated by the desktop build (generated/), so it never runs
# the rexglue tool: that would be built for the device and cannot run here.
# Build with tools/android/build.sh.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(skate1_android LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

get_filename_component(SKATE1_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../.." ABSOLUTE)
add_subdirectory("${SKATE1_ROOT}/third_party/rexglue-sdk" rexglue-sdk)

include("${SKATE1_ROOT}/generated/default/sources.cmake")
set(SKATE1_GENERATED_DIR "${SKATE1_ROOT}/generated/default")

# The same options generated/rexglue.cmake puts on the recompiled code.
set(SKATE1_RECOMP_OPTIONS -gline-tables-only)

add_library(skate1_recomp OBJECT ${GENERATED_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(skate1_recomp PRIVATE
    "${SKATE1_ROOT}" "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src" "${SKATE1_GENERATED_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(skate1_recomp PRIVATE rex::runtime)
target_compile_options(skate1_recomp PRIVATE ${SKATE1_RECOMP_OPTIONS})
target_precompile_headers(skate1_recomp PRIVATE "${SKATE1_GENERATED_DIR}/skate1_pch.h")
rexglue_apply_target_settings(skate1_recomp)
# The SDK's settings ask for -march=armv8-a; the CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS level wins only
# if it comes last, so repeat it here (see tools/android/build.sh).
target_compile_options(skate1_recomp PRIVATE -march=armv8.2-a)

add_library(main SHARED
    "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/main.cpp"
    "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/gpu_wait.cpp"
    "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/job_wait.cpp"
    "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/skip_intro.cpp"
    "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/perf_log.cpp"
    "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/android_gpu.cpp"
    "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/capture_debug.cpp"
    "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/quit_menu.cpp")
target_include_directories(main PRIVATE
    "${SKATE1_ROOT}" "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src" "${SKATE1_GENERATED_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(main PRIVATE skate1_recomp rex::runtime)
rexglue_apply_target_settings(main)
target_compile_options(main PRIVATE -march=armv8.2-a)
rexglue_configure_target(main GPU_PLUGINS xenos)

# Native D3D layer (docs/native_d3d.md), as on the desktop build: the game's
# draws go to plume's Vulkan device instead of the emulated GPU plugin. Needs
# out/native/shader_cache.cpp (tools/d3d/build_shader_cache.sh) and plume.
option(SKATE1_NATIVE_GPU "Build the native D3D layer into libmain.so" OFF)
if(SKATE1_NATIVE_GPU)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${SKATE1_ROOT}/out/native/shader_cache.cpp")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "SKATE1_NATIVE_GPU needs out/native/shader_cache.cpp: run tools/d3d/build_shader_cache.sh")
    endif()
    add_subdirectory("${SKATE1_ROOT}/third_party/plume" plume)
    set(SKATE1_NATIVE_SOURCES
        "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/frame_cap.cpp"
        "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/d3d_trace.cpp"
        "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/d3d_trace_runtime.cpp"
        "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/native_gpu/native_gpu.cpp"
        "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/native_gpu/frame_capture.cpp"
        "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/native_gpu/live_renderer.cpp"
        "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/native_gpu/renderer.cpp"
        "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/native_gpu/shader_registry.cpp"
        "${SKATE1_ROOT}/third_party/smol-v/smolv.cpp"
        "${SKATE1_ROOT}/out/native/shader_cache.cpp")
    target_sources(main PRIVATE ${SKATE1_NATIVE_SOURCES})
    set_source_files_properties("${SKATE1_ROOT}/out/native/shader_cache.cpp" PROPERTIES
        INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/native_gpu")
    target_compile_definitions(main PRIVATE SKATE1_NATIVE_GPU=1)
    target_include_directories(main PRIVATE
        "${SKATE1_ROOT}/src/native_gpu" "${SKATE1_ROOT}/third_party/plume" "${SKATE1_ROOT}/third_party/smol-v")
    target_link_libraries(main PRIVATE plume)
endif()

# Custom Vulkan drivers (Turnip, newer Qualcomm drivers) through adrenotools:
# SDL_main loads one from the game folder's driver/ when present; the hook
# libraries ship in the APK next to libmain.so.
add_subdirectory("${SKATE1_ROOT}/third_party/libadrenotools" adrenotools)
target_link_libraries(main PRIVATE adrenotools)
target_compile_definitions(main PRIVATE REX_HAS_ADRENOTOOLS=1)
add_dependencies(main main_hook hook_impl file_redirect_hook gsl_alloc_hook)
